Name: Lysanias
Summary: Lysanias was tetrarch of Abilene when John the Baptist began his ministry. Luke names him alongside the other rulers of that year to date the coming of God's word to John.
KeyStory: Luke lists Lysanias among the rulers of the year John began preaching in the wilderness.
LifeLesson: Even a ruler known only from one verse has his place in God's dated story. No detail of Luke's history is filler.
